description: Submit a bulk find job (a find credit is charged only per email found). Provide "contacts" (array of {firstName,lastName,company}) or "path" (CSV; columns detected from headers like "First Name", "Last Name", "Company Domain"). Duplicates are removed before submitting. Set "output" to wait and save every result to a local CSV in one call.

max_credits.description: refuse to submit if the job could cost more than this

output.description: wait, then write all results to this local CSV path

wait.description: wait for the job to finish (default false)

name: kanta_find_bulk
